name: That AI Collection

sources.title: Submit page — 'publish for only $19, or promotion plan from $10'; do-follow link + indexed page promised; explicit rejected categories; AI-draft submission option

requirements: AI tools only — hand-checked AI directory (4,000+ tools)
Publishing costs $19 or a promotion plan starting at $10 — no free route
Hard rejections: NSFW/AI companions, face-swap/deepfakes, voice cloning, watermark removal, bulk scraping/lead harvesting/spam automation, academic cheating, surveillance/stalkerware
Paid listing includes: dedicated indexed page, do-follow link, 'Latest Additions' homepage + GitHub feature, and ability to publish a product-review blog post
preparation: AI tool URL — 'Submit with AI' can auto-draft the listing from the URL
Details, pricing plans info, images for the 4-step form (Details → Additional Information → Pricing Plans → Finish)
Contact pavel@ai-collection.org for multi-app discounts or fixes
workflow: Optionally use 'Submit with AI' (paste URL, AI drafts the listing — review/edit every field) or fill manually
Complete the 4-step wizard; progress persists in localStorage so you can resume
Pay $19 (or pick a promotion plan) on the payment step
Listing publishes as an indexed tool page; appears in 'Latest Additions'
watchFor: Seed 'pricing: paid' confirmed — there is no zero-cost option
Don't try to sneak banned categories under other labels — they check every submission
Edits go through email (pavel@ai-collection.org); self-serve editing is only 'on the roadmap'
Promotion plans are sold separately from/after the base listing
countsAsLive: The tool has a dedicated indexed page on thataicollection.com and appears in 'Latest Additions' on the homepage/GitHub
